notes.title: Version 3C
notes.content:
Another Star on Steam has just received its latest bug fix update, version 3C. This update primarily focuses on minor bug fixes, including one crash. No new content has been added. Please report any problems you have with the game, so that they can be fixed as soon as possible.

You can return to version 3B by selecting it from the "betas" tab after right clicking on the game in your Steam library.

Here is the change list:

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list][*]Venom no longer crashes the game when cast by an enemy.
[*]Playtime should no longer appear to "reset" every 24 hours.
[*]Some screen transitions that did not line up correctly have been altered.
[*]Father's Pendant no longer heals to full with the Herb Pin.
[*]The Walking Stick now applies attack power correctly.
[*]The in-game icons for the "Student" and "Scholar" achievements are now correct and match the Steam icons.
[*]Ever move typo corrections.[/list]

notes.title: Version 3B
notes.content:
Another Star on Steam has been updated to version 3B, which contains some minor bug fixes and finally fixes support for the recent OS X El Capitan update. Please report any problems that you are having with the new version, so that they can be fixes as soon as possible.

You can return to version 3A by selecting it from the "betas" tab after right clicking on the game in your Steam library.

Here is the change list:

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]
[list][*]Added a last-resort legacy mode for very old OpenGL 2.x systems that can be enabled using the command line arguments "-l" or "legacy". Will create lots of visual artifacts and messes up the non-square aspect ratio of the game, but should at least allow the game to run on really old laptops and such.[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list][*] Sounds effects are not automatically re-enabled on startup if they were disabled in the user's settings, or using command line arguments.
[*] Made minor tweaks to OpenGL extension functions to allow startup using OpenGL 2.x drivers that have certain OpenGL 3 capabilities but don't consider them to be extensions for whatever reason.
[*] Fixed a bug introduced in Version 3A that prevented the game from ignoring repeated keyboard input from holding down a key.
[*] Fixed a number of issues that were preventing the OS X version from booting in El Capitan.
[*] The progress meter should now correctly reset when erasing a save and starting a new game in that slot.
[*] More typo corrections.[/list]

notes.title: Version 3A Hotfix
notes.content:
A hotfix has been released that addresses a couple issues in the recent Another Star 3A release.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the game would not correctly initialize keyboard controls because of a missing line in the source code.
[*]Missing Linux .so libraries needed to run the game in SteamOS are now included in the install folder.[/list]

notes.title: Version 3A
notes.content:
Another Star on Steam has been updated to version 3A, containing a number of bug fixes. Furthermore, the Linux version should no longer require an installation of Mono.

Please report any problems you are having with the new version, so that they can be fixed as soon as possible.

Here is the change log:

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]
[list][*]All hotkeys are now (mostly) customizable in the settings file.[/list]

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[list][*]Major overhaul on the game's backend.[/list]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed crash at startup if a key enumeration value in the settings file did not exist.
[*]The numeric keypad keys are now enumerated.
[*]You can now play the game with any gamepad connected to the system, as intended, not just the first player gamped.
[*]Phials no longer cause battles to get stuck when consumed.
[*]Attempting to open the menu and move on the same frame no longer confuses the engine to allow the player to skip/ignore warping and scripting tiles.
[*]Fixed an issue with the achievements "Pupil" and "Apprentice" not firing correctly. These two achievements will be awarded upon loading a save if the game detects they have been earned but not yet unlocked.
[*]The "Excavator" achievement should now fire more consistently.
[*]Returning to the Shaman's hut after completing the related side-quest no longer causes the game to freeze.
[*]Fixed a visual glitch on the Vision Riders logo screen when resetting the game.
[*]More typos corrected.[/list]
